note: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting improvements.
title: Decadal average: Annual injury rate from floods
subtitle: Rates are measured per 100,000 people. Decadal figures are measured as the annual average over the subsequent ten-year period. Floods include riverine, coastal, and flash floods, as well as glacial lake outburst floods (when water held back by a glacier or moraine is suddenly released).
